mike_sales: Heads-up  Lynx CTO wants an exec sync today. Requirements: pilot SLA, BYO KMS, EU-only data residency. Legal flagged indemnity. Need fast unblock.
anya_solutions: Copy. Which SLA numbers are they requesting? Region specifics? @maria_security can BYO KMS for a pilot?
jess_eng: I need QPS and token lengths to judge latency SLOs. 50ms p95 at 50 QPS is tight.
mike_sales: They asked for 99.9% uptime and ~50ms p95 for <=512 tokens at ~50 QPS. 60-day pilot, option to convert to dedicated.
leo_infra: BYO KMS + EU-only routing is feasible on Dedicated/Private. Hosted won't satisfy BYO KMS without contract change. We can spin a dedicated VPC in eu-west1 + KMS bind. ETA ~72h post-legal signoff.
maria_security: BYO OK with attestation: key ARN, policy, rotation cadence. Confirm: Redwood holds no key material. If customer demands key escrow we need legal review.
natalie_revops: I can approve a 20% pilot credit. For conversion pricing we need expected GPUs/hours and avg tokens/day to propose a 6-12mo reserved offer.
anya_solutions: I'll draft a 1-pager for the CTO call (tech bullets + asks). Who owns SLO wording?
jess_eng: I can own SLO snippet. Draft:
```
- Availability: 99.9% monthly uptime (excl scheduled maintenance)
- Latency: p95 <= 60ms for <=512 tokens on dedicated pool at 50 QPS
- Incident response: P1 ack < 15m, updates every 2h
- Fallback: automatic route to compatible model variant
```
leo_infra: Note hitting <=60ms p95 needs A100-class or tuned T4 dedicated nodes + quantized model. Hardware affects price and provisioning time.
maria_security: Also require no cross-region backups and signed VPC addendum. I'll prep KMS checklist + attestation template.
sam_legal: Send indemnity redline. We can't accept unusually broad indemnities without contract committee signoff; pilot-scoped exceptions possible.
exec-bot: Exec call slot available in 1h. Use template `exec_pilot_template_v2`.
mike_sales: I'll request 15:00 CET. If confirmed, need infra ticket, perf demo, contract redlines prepped. Competitor demo in 48h, so timeline is tight. :grimacing:
anya_solutions: Assembling exec one-pager now. Tagging @natalie_revops for pilot credit approval and @leo_infra to pre-create infra ticket.
leo_infra: Pre-creating ticket TICKET-5501. Need customer peering details and contact to proceed once legal clears.
jess_eng: I'll prep a short perf harness. If they provide sample prompts (10k tokens/day), I can run pre-call tests.
maria_security: Sending SOC2 and KMS checklist to their security lead. Security mailbox: security@redwood.ai.
mike_sales: Thanks all. Keep this tight, update thread when call confirmed. :thumbsup:
